sources.title: Bring Your Own Model to Foundry Agent Service - Microsoft Foundry
sources.snippet: Foundry Agent Service allows you to connect and use models hosted behind your AI gateways such as Azure API Management or other non-Azure managed AI model gateways. This capability, called bring your own model, allows you to maintain control over your model endpoints while using Foundry agent capabilities.
